main_body: Wooden weapon rack: a top rail and a base beam joined by side posts, with a mid shelf bar and four weapons standing in it
top_band: Top beam: light tan rows 8-11, then a darker brown front face rows 12-13. Base beam: light tan rows 24-27, then a darker front face rows 28-29.
evidence: Both the upper rail and the base beam show a multi-row light top surface (about 4 rows). Under each is a darker front face, with a darker row under the lighter edge acting as an eave shadow. The open frame stays in 3/4 view, with legs and posts below the beams. The mid shelf bar is thinner but also has a lighter top row. No receding side faces are drawn.

style.evidence: The wood uses about 3-4 tan and brown steps with dark brown tinted outlines, which is fine. The posts, weapon shafts and blades are large flat columns of one colour, with almost no grain, knots or speckle. The blades carry only 2-3 grey tones. Next to the stall and well references, which have tile scallops, stone shading and many small details, each tile carries fewer colours and less texture, so it looks thinner and flatter.
